| Category = Soup recipes

}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
* 200 g [[cookbook:Beans|white beans]]
* 2–3 [[cookbook:carrot|carrot]]s
* ½ a [[cookbook:celery|celery]]
* 1 [[cookbook:onion|onion]]
* 1–2 [[cookbook:tomato|tomato]]es
* 1–2 [[cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]]s
* 1–2 [[Cookbook:Chiles|chiles]]
* Optional: [[cookbook:parsley|parsley]], [[cookbook:mint|mint]], [[cookbook:Sunflower Oil|sunflower oil]], [[cookbook:salt|salt]]

== Preparation ==
# [[Cookbook:Soaking Beans|Soak]] the beans in cold water for 3–4 hours. Drain and cover with fresh water.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] beans in an earthenware pot together with the oil, finely chopped carrots, onion, and celery. Cook until beans are tender.
# Add sliced peppers, grated tomatoes, and mint.
# Season with salt and boil for another 15–20 minutes.
# Serve sprinkled with finely-chopped parsley.
